name: webchat-api
description: OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API over a real webchat tab (Puppeteer) with tool-call support

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node --check server.js && node --check bin/webchat.js
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 harness_tests/*.test.js && node harness_tests/cli_smoke.js && bash harness_tests/verify-launchers.sh
